title: Wave Roadmap (T07)
subtitle: Waves, milestones and deliverables of the selected initiatives. The timeline, the initiative table and the work board show the same data.

waves.title: Waves
waves.intro: Waves are overlapping planning horizons, not deadlines.
waves.caption: Roadmap waves with purpose, typical horizon, entry criteria and exit evidence
waves.provisionalAr: Provisional Arabic translation of the source text; the English source text is shown below each wave name.
waves.source: The four seeded waves are the playbook's T07 text (B0079), shown verbatim.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.intro: Wave horizons in weeks from the start of the transformation, and the milestones by forecast date (the approved date when there is no forecast).
timeline.overlap: Horizons overlap by design. No critical path is shown: this stage has no duration-based scheduling model.
timeline.noDated: No milestone has a forecast or approved date yet.

table.title: Initiative table
table.intro: Each initiative with its wave, planned dates, next milestone and schedule flags.
table.caption: Initiatives on the roadmap
table.emptyBody: Initiatives appear here once they are created in the portfolio.

board.title: Work board
board.intro: Initiatives by status. Status changes are made with the initiative's actions in the portfolio, never by editing the status directly.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.intro: Moving a milestone changes its forecast date. The approved date is the baseline and is set by approving a date.
milestones.caption: Milestones with approved date, forecast date and variance
milestones.calendarDays: Variance is the forecast date minus the approved date, in calendar days.
milestones.moveBody: Change the forecast date. The timeline, the initiative table and the work board update together.
milestones.approveBody: The approved date becomes the baseline for variance.
milestones.reasonHint: Required: 3 to 1,000 characters, recorded in the audit trail.
milestones.reapproveHint: Required for a re-approval: explain why the baseline date changes (3 to 1,000 characters).

deliverables.title: Deliverables
deliverables.intro: A deliverable is submitted, then accepted or rejected by the initiative's executive owner, who cannot be the person who submitted it.
deliverables.caption: Deliverables and their acceptance
deliverables.ownSubmission: You submitted this; another person decides it.
deliverables.decideBody: Record your acceptance decision for this deliverable.

flag.schedule__needed_by_conflict: Needed-by conflict: the predecessor finishes after the date it is needed
flag.schedule__unknown: Schedule Unknown: a date needed for the check is missing
flag.capacity__over_allocated: Capacity conflict: demand above available capacity

problem.milestone__actual_date_status: An actual date fits only an achieved milestone, and an achieved milestone needs one.
problem.milestone__cancelled: This milestone is cancelled and cannot be changed.
problem.deliverable__not_owner: Only the initiative's executive owner (or their delegate) can accept or reject this deliverable.
problem.deliverable__acceptor_is_submitter: The person who submitted the deliverable cannot accept or reject it.
problem.deliverable__not_submitted: Only a submitted deliverable can be accepted or rejected.
problem.deliverable__not_submittable: Only a pending or rejected deliverable can be submitted.
